Preview: 400 lumens, 95 g, 40 hours. Good timing if you've got a trip coming up.
Body: If you've got miles planned after dark — whether that's an alpine start, a late camp setup, or just reading in the tent — the Northbay Beacon is worth having in your kit.

Here's what it does: 400 lumens of output, 40 hours of runtime on a charge, and it refuels over USB-C. At 95 grams, it won't be the thing you notice in your pack.

It's a solid single-activity headlamp. It's not built for diving or serious waterproofing demands — check the spec sheet if your conditions are extreme.

Through Tuesday, it's 25% off. If you've been sitting on it, now's a reasonable time to pick one up.
